newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo-Mitsubishi says to cut June debenture coupon.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo-Mitsubishi says to cut June debenture coupon.

text.p: The Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd said on Tuesday that it would cut the coupon rate of its June five-year bank debenture to 2.0 percent from the May debenture's 2.1 percent.

The action was in line with recent market moves, as the bank's May five-year debentures were last traded at 2.0 percent on Monday, and brings Tokyo-Mitsubishi's debentures into line with those of the Industrial Bank of Japan (IBJ), considered the benchmark of the five-year debenture market.
IBJ said on Monday that it would cut the coupon rate for its five-year debentures to be issued in June to two percent from the May issue's 2.2 percent.

In an unusual move, Tokyo-Mitsubishi set the coupon rate for its May debentures below the rate for IBJ debentures. A Tokyo-Mitsubishi spokesman said the bank's decision for June was taken "in accord with current market and fund-raising conditions," but did not elaborate.
